legend.retrievable: the datum exists and can be fetched — worth a trip
legend.source_gap: the datum does not exist in the source — do not re-parse

blurb_missing.why: PDF text layer drops prose at some column and section breaks. Recover by reading those pages visually, or with a layout-aware extractor.

blurb_possibly_truncated.why: Unusually short blurb — may be cut off mid-sentence at a page break. Chase Brown is the confirmed case. Worth spot-checking against the PDF.

no_udk_consistency_pct.why: Player has fewer than the reporting threshold of games in the 3-year window, or is absent from UDK's consistency report. Not retrievable from this source.

no_udk_consistency_charts.why: Absent from UDK's historical finish table.

no_udk_market_share.why: UDK publishes NO QB market share file, so all 36 QBs are structurally absent. Non-QBs here are simply outside the report.

no_udk_red_zone.why: No red-zone usage recorded in the source.

tags_unpopulated.why: My Guy / Value / Sleeper / Breakout / Bust / Injury Concerns render as glyphs the text layer drops. Only Rookie is derived (from exp == 0). This is Phase 4.

te_games_and_finish_null.why: Cropped out of the source page layout for every TE — a layout gap, not a sampling gap. Recoverable with a visual pass over the TE pages.

absent_from_rankings.why: Present in UDK's own Value Scout top-250 but with no row in the rankings PDF — confirmed by searching the PDF text, where the name appears only inside other players' blurbs. UDK is inconsistent with itself here; this is NOT an extraction defect. Nothing can attach to these players.

players.name: Najee Harris
players.detail: Value Scout TrueValue 17.10 / ADP 19.04, no rankings row

impossible_value.why: Source lists a games total above the 17-game maximum. Kept as-is rather than silently corrected.

adp_edge_uncomputable.why: TrueValue or Average ADP is the literal string 'Undrafted' in Value Scout, so no pick differential exists.

notes_not_yet_written.why: Phase 5 scope is the top 200 by UDK overall value. These remain.
